name: Semantic Disconnect via Algorithmic Simulation
description: Replaced the arithmetic divisibility rule with a 4-state permutation group simulation (the Klein four-group). The LLM must either trace the state machine accurately to recover the XOR truth table and then realize it implies undirected bipartiteness, or risk falling into a trap where treating it as a directed 2-SAT problem leads to TLE/WA when trying to satisfy the lexicographically smallest constraint.
